clips.title: Cobalt Circuit
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Blue light running through my shoes
Skip the frame and change the rules
Left right, let the signal spin
I fall out and jump back in
clips.description: fast UK garage shuffle: running-man switches, heel-toe swivels, double knee rebounds, sharp arm diagonals and a quick quarter-turn back to camera

clips.title: Scarlet Static
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Red thread pulling at the seam
I am louder than the screen
Cut the noise and kick the floor
Static wants a little more
clips.description: explosive electroclash punk footwork: rapid stomping heel changes, angular elbow strikes, chest pops, a low springing dip and a sharp pivot with arms slicing overhead

clips.title: Orchid Protocol
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Soft edges, iron will
Watch me move while time stands still
Every fold remembers you
I bloom in a different hue
clips.description: fluid but strongly accented contemporary R&B: fast wrist tutting, rolling shoulders, deep body waves, a grounded side lunge, sharp pauses and an elastic upward rebound

clips.title: Citrus Riot
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Bounce it back, the sun is up
Orange sparks inside my cup
Too much color, not enough
Turn the quiet inside out
clips.description: high-energy Jersey club: fast lateral foot taps, alternating knee lifts, bouncing chest accents, tiny quick hops, waist-level hand patterns and a celebratory overhead arm sweep

clips.title: Mint Condition
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Fresh start on a broken beat
Mint condition, moving feet
Fold the room and bend the line
Every little glitch is mine
clips.description: precise acid-house jack: rhythmic torso jack, fast heel-toe footwork, rolling arm isolations, low knee bends, controlled head accents and a quick spin that settles facing front

clips.title: Chrome Fever
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Chrome fever under my skin
Break the shell and let me in
Strike a spark, erase the gray
I rebuild a brighter shape
clips.description: athletic industrial-pop choreography: double chest hits, robotic wrist isolations, long diagonal punches, fast crossing steps, a low dip and sharp whole-body stop

clips.title: Rose Voltage
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Rose voltage lights the room
Spin the night into a bloom
Hands like ribbons, feet like fire
Turn the love a little higher
clips.description: joyful disco waacking: rapid arm circles behind the shoulders, long elegant wrist flourishes, syncopated side steps, quick heel pivots, a deep knee bounce and radiant eye contact

clips.title: Ultraviolet Rush
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Ultraviolet in my veins
Running free between the frames
Catch the light before it lands
Turn to stars inside my hands
clips.description: fast drum-and-bass step: alternating heel kicks, tight traveling foot switches, quick double shoulder hits, arm waves, a short controlled spin and powerful diagonal reach

clips.title: Lime Geometry
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Angle in and angle out
Let the body draw it loud
Lime geometry, no straight line
Move the shape and make it mine
clips.description: broken-beat popping: crisp forearm ticks, segmented body wave, rapid heel-toe slides, knee rebound, a clean sideways glide and deep rhythmic shoulder isolations

clips.title: Pearl Afterhours
clips.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Pearl light after the rush
Hear the thunder in the hush
Every seam becomes a song
Take me where the beats belong
clips.description: percussive club fusion: fast grounded foot switches, flowing wrist circles, alternating sharp shoulder drops, a broad fabric sweep, half-turn and springing forward step

clips.title: Face / Focus
clips.lyrics:
[Verse]
Cut my silhouette out of the screen
Acid on the seams, living in between
Whole room still but my body says go
Step out of the frame, let the edges overflow
[Chorus]
Pull me close, then let me go
Break into color, steal the show
Fall apart, come back on beat
All my pieces move with me
[Outro]
Close, close, let me go
All my pieces move with me
clips.description: The original long-form vocal particle performance.
